Command: Utterly destroy the seven nations of Canaan
Summary: Deuteronomy 20:17 commands the utter destruction of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites — the seven nations of the land — as the LORD commanded.
Commandment: Utterly destroy the seven nations of Canaan, as the LORD commanded.
Application: Scripture states the purpose plainly: that they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods (Deuteronomy 20:18). The campaign belonged to the conquest generation; it does not govern any modern army.
Purpose: To restrain war even in conquest: offer peace, exempt the newly married and fearful, spare fruit trees (Deuteronomy 20). These laws bounded Israel's wars and do not govern any modern army as Mosaic law.
